notes: MAC-then-encrypt: the tag is computed over the plaintext and sealed inside the ciphertext, so unseal must decrypt attacker-supplied bytes before it can authenticate anything. Padding errors during that decrypt are observable, which is a padding oracle that recovers the plaintext. The MAC is also truncated to 64 bits, and the comparison uses == rather than a constant-time routine. AES-GCM would remove all three failures.
